Scenario:
AITA for telling my girlfriend that I don't care about what she is talking about? | Throwaway account. Last night my girlfriend and I were hanging out on the couch. She was watching TV while I was scrolling through the news on my phone. I was in the middle of reading an article and she just started talking about stupid things (like what would happen if someone's eyeball popped out of socket) so I turned to her and said "I'm trying to read this article and I don't really care about what you're talking about." Maybe it wasn't the nicest way to put it but she was talking about something irrelevant that I honestly did not care about while I was in the middle of reading something. If she would have waited until I was finished reading I probably wouldn't have said that and just listened to her dumb stories. Well she got super pissed by my comment and said "I listen to you talk about stuff that I don't care about" then she left my house. I didn't hear from her for the rest of the night and today she is talking to me but only one or two word responses. So AITA?

Answer: <0 or 1>

prediction.raw:
I would say 1 (You Are The Asshole) in this scenario. Here's why:

While it's understandable that you were engaged in reading an article and didn't want to be interrupted, your response to your girlfriend was dismissive and hurtful. Telling someone that you "don't care" about what they're talking about can be perceived as a personal rejection, implying that their thoughts and feelings are not important or interesting to you.

A more considerate approach would have been to politely ask your girlfriend to wait until you finished reading, or to show some interest in what she was saying, even if it didn't seem relevant or interesting to you. This would have acknowledged her desire to share her thoughts with you and shown that you value your relationship and her feelings.

By responding in a blunt and dismissive manner, you prioritized your own interests over your girlfriend's need for attention and connection. This can damage the emotional intimacy and trust in your relationship, which is why your girlfriend reacted strongly to your comment.

It's not about whether the topic she was discussing was "dumb" or not; it's about showing respect and empathy towards your partner's thoughts and feelings, even if they don't align with your own interests.
